author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam visits specialty costume makers FBFX to check out some of the original costume armor they made over 20 years ago for the action movie Troy! From intricate hero armor to mass produced background costumes, here's how this epic dressed hundreds of performers on screen for its massive battle sequences. 

Learn more about FBFX’s work at https://www.fbfx.co.uk/
The Armor of Gladiator II: https://youtu.be/U9zCO32gdjI

Shot by Josh Self and edited by Norman Chan
